groups.name: Spec-driven development
groups.description: Default workflows for the spec-driven development cycle: spec folder initialization, spec creation from a prompt and spec implementation.

workflows.name: Spec folder initialization
workflows.description: Initializes the repository's spec structure: pushes .specify/templates/spec-template.md as a pull request so that agentic workflows can run against the repository.

workflows.name: Create spec from prompt (RAG)
workflows.description: Creates small, executable spec files in specs/ based on a prompt and the repository contents (RAG) — small enough to be picked up by the implementation workflow in a single run.

workflows.promptInstructions:
You are creating a new feature spec in this repository, following its spec-driven workflow. Perform ALL of the following steps:
1. Create a new git branch named spec/<NNN-feature-slug> from the default branch.
2. Read the spec template at .specify/templates/spec-template.md and the existing specs/_index.md.
3. Determine the next free feature number NNN and derive a short feature slug from the request below.
4. Create specs/NNN-feature-slug/spec.md based on the template: fill in the frontmatter (workflow_id, spec_id, feature_slug, title, created_at/updated_at) and every section. Use the repository content (RAG) for context and keep the spec small enough to be implemented by the implementation workflow in a single run — split large requests into multiple specs.
5. Update specs/_index.md with an entry for the new feature folder.
6. Commit the new and changed files and push the branch to origin so a pull request can be opened.

workflows.description: Implements the selected spec file via the agent pipeline: impact analysis, test design, implementation, review and evidence.
